steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
Peel and deseed the melon, then grate it finely and squeeze out excess liquid with a clean cloth.
In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
Add mashed banana, canola oil, and egg to the dry ingredients and stir until a thick dough forms.
Fold in the grated melon until evenly distributed throughout the dough.
Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the prepared pan, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until the top is golden and the centre feels set when pressed.
Cool completely in the pan, then cut into 12 bars. Makes 4 family portions; keep refrigerated up to 3 days.
